nextGame.note: Saturday afternoon road game in Tampa, Florida. Half past two our time. The game is on ESPN+, which comes with YouTube TV at no extra charge, so it plays in the ESPN app instead of the channel list. It is the last game of the regular season. Tulane beat North Texas on Saturday to reach six wins and five losses, so the Green Wave is going to a bowl game. South Florida has won six games and lost five.

news.headline: Tulane beats North Texas 28-24 and makes a bowl
news.summary: Trace Johnson threw four touchdown passes, and the last one, to Cameron Roberts with 2:13 left, put Tulane ahead for the first time. The Green Wave has won six games and lost five and is going to a bowl game for the fifth year in a row.

news.headline: Cooper Helmke is up for a national kicking award
news.summary: Tulane kicker Cooper Helmke is one of 20 players still in the running for the Lou Groza Award, which goes to the best kicker in the country. He has made 13 of his 15 field goals this year, and his longest was from 58 yards.

news.headline: Tulane's last road game is set for 2:30 Saturday
news.summary: Tulane plays at South Florida on Saturday, November 28, at half past two in the afternoon. The game is on ESPN+, which comes with YouTube TV at no extra charge.

nextGame.note: Friday afternoon road game in Tallahassee against Florida State. Half past two our time, on Channel 26. It is the last game of the regular season and the oldest rivalry Florida has. Florida has won seven games and lost four after beating Vanderbilt on Saturday. Florida State has won five games and lost six.

news.headline: Florida beats Vanderbilt 34-27 on senior day
news.summary: Florida trailed 24-17 at halftime and came back to win its last home game. Jadan Baugh scored the go-ahead touchdown with 2:19 left, and Eric Singleton caught passes for 117 yards, the most of his career.

news.headline: Sumrall says the Gators won in spite of themselves
news.summary: Jon Sumrall was not pleased after the win and called his team sloppy. He joked that the game aged everyone who watched it ten years.

news.headline: Sumrall did not like Tuesday's practice
news.summary: Florida's coach stopped a slow practice and made the team run six plays of full-contact goal line work. He said the Gators have not handled winning well this year.

nextGame.note: Friday night road game at Texas A&M, the day after Thanksgiving. Half past six our time, on Channel 26. It is the last game of the regular season. Texas has won nine games and lost two after beating Arkansas 45-3 on Saturday. Texas A&M has won four games and lost seven.

news.headline: Texas runs over Arkansas 45-3
news.summary: Arch Manning threw for 287 yards and two touchdowns and ran for a third, completing 21 of his 25 passes. Texas led 31-3 at halftime and has now won five games in a row.

news.headline: Colin Simmons is up for the best defensive player award
news.summary: Simmons is one of the finalists for the Bronko Nagurski Trophy, given to the best defensive player in college football. It is the second national award he has been named a finalist for this week.

news.headline: Colin Simmons is a finalist for a national award
news.summary: Texas pass rusher Colin Simmons is one of four finalists for the Lombardi Award, which goes to the best lineman or linebacker in the country. The winner is named on December 9 in Houston.

nextGame.note: Today's game is over. The Saints lost at Chicago 21-13. Chicago sacked Tyler Shough six times, and Alvin Kamara caught the only New Orleans touchdown. The Saints have now won three games and lost seven. They play at Cincinnati next Sunday at noon our time, on Channel 4.

news.headline: Chicago beats the Saints 21-13
news.summary: Chicago sacked Tyler Shough six times, once for a safety, and the Saints scored one touchdown, a one-yard catch by Alvin Kamara. New Orleans has now won three games and lost seven.

news.headline: Tyler Shough practices without the glove on his hand
news.summary: The Saints quarterback has been playing with two broken bones in his left hand, and this week he practiced without the glove he had been wearing over it. The team has not said the hand is healed.

news.headline: Jordan Howden takes over at safety
news.summary: Justin Reid asked the Saints to let him go on Thursday after starting the first nine games. Jordan Howden, who is in his fourth year with the team, starts next to Julian Blackmon on Sunday.

tv.name: PSAC Sports Digital Network app
tv.note: Free. Every IUP volleyball game is on this app. Tap the link on game day and look for the match.

nextGame.note: IUP plays Gannon today for the Atlantic Region championship. Three o'clock our time, four o'clock theirs, at the Highmark Events Center in Erie, Pennsylvania. Every IUP volleyball game is shown free on the PSAC Sports Digital Network app, so tap the link just above on game day and look for the match. You can also search PSAC on a phone, an Apple TV or a Fire TV. This one is a national tournament match that Gannon is hosting, and NCAA.com is also carrying it live at ncaa.com/game/6663021. IUP has won twenty-five games and lost six. Gannon is the top seed with twenty-six wins and five losses. The winner goes to the final eight teams in the country.

news.headline: IUP beats Clarion to reach the regional final
news.summary: IUP won in four sets Saturday night in Erie, 25-19, 25-22, 30-32, 27-25. Jessica Neiman had 14 kills, and Delaney Concannon had 11 kills and 21 digs.

news.headline: Peyton Belcher had 6 kills against Gannon
news.summary: Peyton was back on the court Saturday night for the first time since October 23. She played three of the four sets and had 6 kills on 23 swings with 3 errors, plus a block at the net.

news.headline: Peyton Belcher is named a Provost Scholar
news.summary: IUP put Peyton on its fall list of Provost Scholars, which the school gives to juniors and seniors with a grade average of 3.5 or better. A student can only get it once, and she is studying psychology.

nextGame.note: Baseball is finished until the spring. The Yankees open the new season at home against Toronto on Thursday, March 25, at twenty-five to one in the afternoon. No channel has been announced yet.

news.headline: The Yankees let go of Luis Gil and Fernando Cruz
news.summary: Both pitchers were cut loose Friday and can now sign with any team. Gil was the best rookie in the American League in 2024, but a sore shoulder cost him more than three months this past season.

news.headline: The Yankees bring back pitcher Jonathan Loaisiga
news.summary: Loaisiga agreed to a two-year deal worth $18 million to return to New York, where he pitched from 2018 through 2025. He spent this past season in Arizona and stayed healthy all year.

news.headline: Brian Cashman slept outside at Yankee Stadium
news.summary: The Yankees' general manager spent Thursday night in the outfield to raise money for homeless young people in New York. It was his fifteenth year doing the Covenant House Sleep Out.

news.headline: Evangel ends Warren Easton's season 52-14
news.summary: The Eagles lost Friday night in Shreveport in the first round of the state playoffs. Warren Easton finishes the year with four wins and seven losses.

news.headline: Warren Easton makes the playoffs and will travel to Shreveport
news.summary: The state playoff brackets came out Sunday. Warren Easton is the 21st seed and plays at Evangel in Shreveport, which is the 12th seed.

news.headline: Bonnabel beats Warren Easton 29-28
news.summary: The Eagles lost by one point at home Thursday night in the last game of their regular season. Warren Easton finishes the year 4-6, and the state playoff pairings are not out yet.
